verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms PagerDuty serves a genuine llms.txt file (HTTP 200 with structured knowledge-base content) at support.pagerduty.com/llms.txt, directly matching the story, and this is complemented by developer docs and a runtime-verified MCP server for agent-oriented access. Missing for 10: no evidence the llms.txt is comprehensive/linked from primary docs nav or independent community confirmation of agents successfully using it.
